title: Cymut X Mutrobo RPG
description:
Character Choice and CyMu (Cymut and Mutrobo)Choose a character and CyMu of your choice to start your journey.

CyMu CaptureBuild a strong team, trying to capture your favorite CyMu.
You can also capture the Special Cymut or Special Mutrobo which are much stronger but only appear at random times and locations.

Evolution of CyMuIs it difficult to capture? Then gather the necessary items to evolve your CyMu.

CyMu CollectionComplete your Cymut collection to earn a Special Cymut, which is much stronger.
Complete your Mutrobo collection to earn a Special Mutrobo, which is much stronger.

InventoryWhen you defeat an enemy, collect their loot, which will be sent directly to your inventory.

Big bossGet ready to face the six bosses, one from each element (Water/Ice, Electric, Plant, Evil Wind, Fire, Earth).

2 player modePlay with a friend on the same computer in 2 player mode.
Player 1 requires a keyboard and mouse, player 2 requires a joystick (Gamepad).

Help Dr. AlbertThe main objective of the game is to deliver the 6 Boomags to Dr. Albert because only he can save us from this uncontrolled mutation of Cymuts and Mutrobos.
description_short: CYMUT X MUTROBO is an action RPG, become a trainer of Cymut and Mutrobo and live the experience of farming, picking up items, exploring a huge world, completing quests, capturing and evolving up to 60 Cymuts and 60 Mutrobos to collect and use in battle.
